migration_list_execution.error_message: IPv6 is not supported on your current network. Run supabase link --project-ref cqrslxngpwbtkjejlwty to setup IPv4 connection.
migration_list_execution.technical_blocker_analysis: The direct PostgreSQL endpoint (db.cqrslxngpwbtkjejlwty.supabase.co:5432) resolves strictly to an IPv6 address (AAAA record) without an IPv4 (A record). The local network host lacks IPv6 routing. In standard Supabase CLI workflows, 'supabase link' queries the Supabase Management API to configure the IPv4 connection pooler; this requires a SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN or interactive operator authentication.

local_filename_handling.timestamped_files: Files with 14-digit timestamps (20261025095847 through 20261025100654) match the exact version strings recorded in remote staging. The CLI correlates local and remote rows 1:1.
local_filename_handling.legacy_sequential_files: Files with 3-digit prefixes (001_ through 015_) parse valid version identifiers ('001' to '015'), but do NOT match any of the five 14-digit remote entries. In a live migration list, they would appear as LOCAL: PRESENT, REMOTE: UNAPPLIED.

cli_filename_recognition_and_reporting_r.critical_distinction: Remote tracking row status indicates whether a version is logged in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations. Inferred schema-execution status indicates whether PostgreSQL catalog objects actually exist. A migration must never be marked applied or replayed without reconciling both dimensions.
